description: The plot illustrates two accuracy series across a set of discrete x-axis positions, showing “Initial Accuracy” and “Final Accuracy” with error bars. The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows values from 1 to 19 with regularly spaced tick labels every 2 units (1, 3, 5, …, 19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. The “Initial Accuracy” line is green with square markers and a solid line; it starts near 0.34 at x=1, rises to about 0.49 at x=5, drops to about 0.29 at x=7, increases to about 0.52 at x=13, then declines to about 0.36 at x=17 and ends around 0.41 at x=19, with vertical error bars at each point. The “Final Accuracy” line is blue with circular markers and a dashed line; it begins around 0.65 at x=1, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, dips to about 0.72 at x=7, peaks near 0.92 at x=9, falls to about 0.69–0.70 around x=11–13, rises again to about 0.90 at x=15, dips to about 0.81 at x=17, and ends near 0.90 at x=19, also with vertical error bars at each point.
